popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus' Argive stemma — Talaus as son of Bias and father of Adrastus, the Aeolid link that puts the Seven Against Thebes under Argive command.

popCulture.title: Seven Against Thebes
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus' siege drama runs on Adrastus' army — Talaus remains the genealogical father of the Argive king who leads the Seven.

popCulture.title: Adrastus
popCulture.description: King of Argos who led the Seven — son of Talaus in the standard stemma that joins the Aeolids to the Theban war.

popCulture.title: Talaus
popCulture.description: Argive king of the Aeolid line — father of Adrastus and hinge between Bias' house and the expedition against Thebes.
